look_here_first: Broad leaf bases usually clasp stem. On ripe capsule, find seed release window near middle; compare with biflora's higher window.

morphology_keys.flower: Blue violet five-lobed single corolla, some flowers closed
morphology_keys.fruit: Inferior capsule with lateral seed-release windows
